title: Memory leak
story: Each request leaks memory. Nothing fails yet. The only signal is resident memory rising in the service's runtime stats.

report.summary: The shop service memory usage is growing abnormally due to an explicitly enabled memory leak fault in the staged demo.
report.root_cause: A memory leak fault was enabled via the admin faults endpoint, causing resident memory usage to climb rapidly.
report.suggested_fix: Disable the memory leak fault via the admin endpoint (DELETE /admin/faults/memory_leak) or restart the service.
